build_SimpleCNN: build a SimpleCNN model with two conv layers and two fully connected layers for MNIST classification
create_combine_state_for_ensemble: create an ensemble by combining states of multiple models using combine_state_for_ensemble to stack parameters
run_vmap_predictions: run vmap on the stateless model to vectorize predictions across an ensemble of models
test_vmap_in_dims: test vmap with in_dims argument to apply the same minibatch across all models in the ensemble
refactor_ensemble_for_loop: refactor a for-loop ensemble prediction into a vectorized vmap call for improved performance
